title: Abandoned Drake Nest
description: A crude nest of scorched bones and volcanic rock sits wedged into a cliffside alcove, still reeking of smoke and charred meat. Shed scales litter the ground like broken mirrors, catching the red glow of distant lava. Whatever drake built this has moved on, but the remains of its kills tell a violent story.

choices.label: Collect shed scales
choices.description: Gather the discarded drake scales scattered around the nest.

outcomes.text: You fill a pouch with gleaming drake scales, each one hard as iron and warm to the touch. Excellent crafting material.
A few scales are worth keeping, but many have cracked in the heat. You grab what you can.
The drake hasn't moved on after all. A furious screech echoes from above as it dives at the intruders!

choices.label: Search the nest
choices.description: Dig through the debris for anything the drake may have hoarded.

outcomes.text: Beneath a pile of charred bones, you find coins and a scorched fang lodged in a prey skull. The drake was a prolific killer.
A few coins glint among the wreckage, but the hoard is mostly bones and ash.
You disturb a clutch of ember beetles nesting in the debris. They swarm over your hands before you can pull back.

choices.label: Leave quietly
choices.description: The drake may not be far. Best not to linger.

outcomes.text: You back away slowly, eyes scanning the sky. Nothing follows. Wisdom, for once, wins over greed.
